name: 608 deep-groove ball bearing (ISO 15 boundary envelope)
summary: Thread-free 608 bearing envelope: 8 mm bore, 22 mm outside diameter, 7 mm wide, modelled as a plain annular ring. Origin on the back face, on the bore axis.
preview: 608 bearing envelope, 8 x 22 x 7 mm, bore and outer ring faces tagged

component.frame: back face on the bore axis; the ring spans 0..+7 in Z
simplifications: boundary envelope only: no raceways, balls, cage or shields
one rigid ring, so nothing rotates relative to anything
